_comment: English texts for src/helpers/processRoles.js's keys (settingsPage.processes.*), for stage 2's locales to copy. Parameters are raw: since/stopsAt are epoch ms and the page formats them; hotkey is the saved accelerator. test/helpers/processRoles.test.js checks every key the module can produce is here.

main.name: Main process
main.what: Runs the app itself: hotkeys, the tray, the History database and requests to providers. It starts every other process.

why.default: Always, while OpenWhispr runs.

gpu.name: Graphics
gpu.what: Draws every OpenWhispr window on the graphics card, or on the CPU when graphics acceleration is off.

why.default: Always. Its graphics memory grows while the screen-edge frame shows.

goesAway.default: When you quit. Graphics memory kept after a frame drops the next time OpenWhispr draws without it.

network.name: Network service
network.what: Chromium's networking: requests to providers, sign-in and update checks.

why.default: Always.

audio.name: Audio service
audio.what: Captures your microphone and plays the start and stop sounds.

why.default: Started the first time OpenWhispr used the microphone or played a sound.

videoCapture.name: Video capture service
videoCapture.what: Chromium's camera service. OpenWhispr never opens a camera.

why.default: OpenWhispr lists your microphones, and Chromium lists cameras in the same call and starts this service to do it.

goesAway.default: Not on its own: Chromium keeps it for the rest of the session.

storage.name: Storage service
storage.what: Chromium's storage for what the windows keep locally, such as your settings.

why.default: Started when a window first used its storage.

controlPanel.name: Control panel window
controlPanel.what: This window: Home, History, Notes, Chat and Settings.

why.default: You opened it.
why.hidden: Hidden since {{since}}. Closing it only hides it, so it stays loaded.
why.hiddenUnknown: It's hidden. Closing it only hides it, so it stays loaded.

dictationWindow.name: Dictation window
dictationWindow.what: The floating icon: records your voice, runs the dictation and pastes the text.

why.default: Always.

goesAway.default: When you quit. Most of its CPU time is spent while you record.

edgeStrip.name: Screen-edge indicator
edgeStrip.what: The strip or frame at the edge of your screen while the microphone is live (Settings › Floating icon › Screen edge).

why.default: Your Screen edge setting is on.
why.kept: Kept after the last recording, so the next one shows it at once.

goesAway.default: A while after the recording ends.
goesAway.afterSeconds: {{seconds}} seconds after the last recording ends.
goesAway.afterMinutes: {{minutes}} minutes after the last recording ends.

companionPill.name: Companion pill
companionPill.what: The small pill that shows a dictation while the assistant panel is open.

why.default: The assistant panel is open.

meetingOverlay.name: Meeting prompt
meetingOverlay.what: The card that offers to transcribe a meeting OpenWhispr detected.

why.default: A meeting was detected.

goesAway.default: When you answer it or it times out.

permissionGuide.name: Permission guide
permissionGuide.what: Points at the right switch in System Settings during setup.

why.default: Setup is asking for a permission.

goesAway.default: When the permission is granted or you close it.

keyListener.name: Key listener
keyListener.what: Watches one hotkey so OpenWhispr knows when you press and release it.

why.default: A hotkey needs it: Hold, or a key Windows can't register on its own.
why.hotkey: Your hotkey {{hotkey}} needs it: Hold, or a key Windows can't register on its own.

goesAway.default: When you quit or change that hotkey.

copilotRuntime.name: GitHub Copilot runtime
copilotRuntime.what: Sends requests to GitHub Copilot: cleanup, styles, translation and note formatting.

why.default: Started for a request to GitHub Copilot.
why.busy: A request to GitHub Copilot is running.

goesAway.stopsIn: After 10 minutes without a request (in about {{minutes}} min).

whisperServer.name: Local Whisper server
whisperServer.what: Transcribes your voice on this PC with a Whisper model.

why.default: You dictate with a local Whisper model.

goesAway.default: When you switch away from local Whisper, or quit.

parakeetServer.name: Parakeet / Cohere server
parakeetServer.what: Transcribes your voice on this PC with a Parakeet or Cohere model.

why.default: You dictate with a local Parakeet or Cohere model.

goesAway.default: When you switch to another model, or quit.

llamaServer.name: Local language model
llamaServer.what: Runs a downloaded language model on this PC for cleanup or chat.

why.default: Cleanup or chat uses a downloaded model.

goesAway.default: When you switch to another model, or quit.

why.default: You searched notes by meaning, or notes are being indexed.

searchWorker.name: Search and speaker worker
searchWorker.what: Turns notes into search vectors and recognizes speakers in meetings, on this PC.

why.default: Note search or speaker recognition needed it.

goesAway.default: Once nothing has used it for a while.

systemAudioHelper.name: Meeting audio
systemAudioHelper.what: Records what other apps play, so the other side of a meeting is transcribed.

why.default: A meeting is being transcribed.

micListener.name: Microphone watcher
micListener.what: Notices when another app starts using the microphone, to detect meetings.

why.default: Meeting detection is on.

goesAway.default: When you turn meeting detection off, or quit.

textMonitor.name: Correction watcher
textMonitor.what: Watches the text field you pasted into, to learn the corrections you make.

why.default: You just pasted a dictation.
A recording or a file is being converted.

meetingAecHelper.name: Meeting echo canceller
meetingAecHelper.what: Removes the other side's voice from your microphone during a meeting.

why.default: A meeting is being transcribed.

diarization.name: Speaker separation
diarization.what: Works out who spoke when in a meeting recording.

why.default: A meeting transcript is being split by speaker.

consoleHost.name: Console host
consoleHost.what: Windows starts one for a command-line program, even a hidden one.

why.default: Its helper program is running.

unknown.name: Other process
unknown.what: A process OpenWhispr started that this page doesn't know.

why.default: Started by OpenWhispr.

goesAway.default: When it finishes, or when you quit.

notRunning.whisperServer: Starts when you dictate with a local Whisper model.
notRunning.parakeetServer: Starts when you dictate with a local Parakeet or Cohere model.
notRunning.llamaServer: Starts when cleanup or chat uses a downloaded model.
notRunning.copilotRuntime: Starts with the first request to GitHub Copilot; stops after 10 idle minutes.
notRunning.qdrant: Starts on the first search by meaning; stops after 5 idle minutes.
notRunning.searchWorker: Starts for note search or speaker recognition.
notRunning.systemAudioHelper: Starts while a meeting is being transcribed.
notRunning.meetingAecHelper: Starts while a meeting is being transcribed.
notRunning.diarization: Starts after a meeting, to separate its speakers.
notRunning.micListener: Starts when meeting detection is on.
notRunning.textMonitor: Starts for 30 seconds after a paste, to learn corrections.
notRunning.edgeStrip: Starts when you record, if Screen edge is on.
